data.act: provision of a benefice without cure of souls in the monastery of St. Leodegar

data.value: fructus non excedentes viginti quinque vel decem et octo marcas argenti
data.regest_de: Felix V. Provisions of a benefice without cure of souls in the monastery of St. Leodegar in the Valley (Val-de-Trons) for Bartholomew de Vivischotensi, a cleric of the diocese of Utrecht, granted to the Bishop of Lausanne and the Abbess of the monastery.
